credits: Original short SpeechCoachAI practice instructions, 2026-10-25. Use a gentle comfortable effort.

items.title: Easy breathing
items.text: Sit comfortably. Breathe in gently, then let the air out slowly. Keep the shoulders relaxed and repeat at an easy pace.

items.title: Gentle humming
items.text: Close the lips lightly and hum at a comfortable pitch. Let the face stay relaxed. Pause for an easy breath between each hum.

items.title: Lip trills
items.text: Relax the lips and let a gentle breath make them flutter. Keep the effort light and stop if it feels uncomfortable.
